spec.title: vscode PROP-005: The readers of the upgrade advisory

status.comment: the type's answer to the advisory question of PROP-016 §2; new with the split of 2026-09-09, stating what the deps-advisory phase of modules/codkit/PROP-009 used to name inline. Implemented in phase P2-3: the readers are functions of this type and the engine keeps only the frame

readers.title: 1. What the advisory reads between two pins

p.VSCODE-ADVISORY-READERS: The semantic readers the cycle runs over the `oldPin..newPin` diff for this type: the files `.nvmrc`, `package.json`, `package-lock.json` and `build/npm/dirs.ts`; the `builtInExtensions` entries of `product.json`; the Electron version and the TypeScript version, read by grep over `build/lib/electron.ts` and `package.json`. Each reader answers "what changed in the toolchain of this distribution"; a reader that finds nothing contributes no line.

p.VSCODE-ADVISORY-FRAME-IS-THE-ENGINES: The frame around these readings - the `deps-advisory` phase, the stop for a human in interactive mode with exit 3, the log line under `--ci`, and the protocol step "stop the daemons with `build down --all` before `npm install` in the tree" - belongs to the engine (`spec://codkit/modules/codkit/PROP-009#PHASE-DEPS-ADVISORY`). Only the list of readers is the type's, and a type that declares no `upgrade-advisory` capability makes the phase an empty report rather than a refusal.
